assessment_requests.input: Explicit fill/repeat/take request in extracted content; unique catalogue id/source id/name/title/title_ru/name_ru/aliases, including localized names. Punctuation and case normalized; no fuzzy match.
assessment_requests.output: New assessment with canonical fingerprint, localized intro and report source/date/deadline; open/snoozed fingerprint skips creation and text fallback.
assessment_requests.failure: Inapplicable, ambiguous or unrecognized request retains original text. Invalid/missing catalogue logs and retains text. Write failure is logged by extraction; no text substitute claiming an executable assessment.
